newsitem.title: GERMANY: German TV advertising revenue rises in 1996.
newsitem.headline: German TV advertising revenue rises in 1996.

text.p: Germany's private television channels increased their advertising revenue to a total gross 10.8 billion marks ($6.5 billion) in 1996, the advertising marketing firm IP Deutschland said on Thursday.

RTL led the pack with 3.2 billion marks in income, increasing its share of total TV advertising spending to 30.1 percent from 29.9 percent, followed by SAT1 at 2.6 billion marks and Pro Sieben at 2.35 billion marks.
Among the public channels, income remained more or less unchanged, with ARD taking in 479 million marks and ZDF with 469 million marks.

RTL also had the highest viewership, with a 17 percent market share, ARD had 14.8 percent and ZDF 14.4 percent, IP Deutschland added, citing data from the consumer reearsch body Gesellschaft fuer Konsumforschung.
